# Phase 0 fixtures — Dhadda Snapshot v1

All fixtures are **synthetic** (no real people, money, or SMS content).
Names like `Asha`/`Bikash` are invented placeholders.

Wire shape follows `lib/models.dart` (`Snapshot.decode`):
`version, updatedAt, deviceId, deviceName, categories[], transactions[], loans[], projects[]`.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `snapshot_empty.json` | Fresh-install shape: all collections empty |
| `snapshot_single.json` | Exactly one expense transaction |
| `snapshot_populated.json` | **Canonical Snapshot v1**: realistic populated app (Step 6) |
| `snapshot_bulk.json` | 300 transactions (generated by `generate_bulk.dart`, seed 42) |
| `snapshot_unicode.json` | Nepali/emoji notes, NPR formatting edge amounts (0.01, 99999999.99) |
| `snapshot_legacy.json` | Legacy shapes the app migrates: pre-fuel categories, `remindFreq`, missing optionals |
| `corrupt_malformed.json` | Truncated JSON — must throw on decode |
| `corrupt_wrongtype.json` | Valid JSON, wrong top-level type — must throw on decode |
| `corrupt_lenient.json` | Wrong field types/unknown enums/duplicate IDs — documents lenient defaults |
| `generate_bulk.dart` | Pure-Dart (`dart:convert` only) deterministic bulk generator. Run: `dart test/fixtures/phase0/generate_bulk.dart` |

Validated by `test/fixtures_test.dart` (counts, totals, migration, throw behavior,
export→import round-trip equivalence).
